children: Forgent plc (AIM: FORG), the Australian-focused critical and precious minerals explorer, is pleased to announce that it has launched a refreshed website, designed to better reflect the Company’s change in primary business strategy and the Australian exploration portfolio.
The website address remains unchanged at: www.forgentplc.com.
For further information on Forgent plc, visit the Company’s website www.forgentplc.com or contact:
Global Investment Strategy UK Ltd – Broker
Billy Clegg / Georgia Edmonds / Fergus Young

Forgent plc is an Australian-focused critical and precious metals exploration company focused on acquiring and advancing gold, copper and nickel assets with existing mineralisation, extensive historical datasets and clear pathways to value creation, supported by an experienced management and technical team.

The Company is strategically positioned to benefit from structural demand for copper, gold and nickel, driven by electrification, data centre investment, electric vehicle adoption and gold’s continued role as a safe-haven asset and central bank reserve holding.

Forgent’s portfolio includes Peak Hill, an advanced gold-copper exploration project; Mount Sholl, a nickel-copper-PGE project with a JORC-compliant resource and significant exploration target; and Green Rocks, a copper-gold project with high-grade surface mineralisation.
